items.name: Fill
items.brief: An abstract class representing the gradient fill of the Shape object.

items.name: Paint
items.brief: An abstract class for managing graphical elements.

items.name: Picture
items.brief: A class representing an image read in one of the supported formats: raw, svg, png, jpg, lot and etc. Besides the methods inherited from the Paint, it provides methods to load & draw images on the canvas.

items.name: Scene
items.brief: A class to composite children paints.

items.name: Shape
items.brief: A class representing two-dimensional figures and their properties.

items.name: Text
items.brief: A class to represent text objects in a graphical context, allowing for rendering and manipulation of unicode text.

items.name: ConicGradient
items.brief: A class representing the conic gradient fill of the Shape object.

items.name: LinearGradient
items.brief: A class representing the linear gradient fill of the Shape object.

items.name: RadialGradient
items.brief: A class representing the radial gradient fill of the Shape object.

items.name: Canvas
items.brief: An abstract class for drawing graphical elements.

items.name: GlCanvas
items.brief: A class for the rendering graphic elements with a GL raster engine.

items.name: SwCanvas
items.brief: A class for the rendering graphical elements with a software raster engine.

items.name: WgCanvas
items.brief: A class for the rendering graphic elements with a WebGPU raster engine.

items.name: Animation
items.brief: The Animation class enables manipulation of animatable images.

items.name: Accessor
items.brief: The Accessor is a utility class to debug the Scene structure by traversing the scene-tree.

items.name: Initializer
items.brief: A class that enables initialization and termination of the TVG engines.

items.name: Saver
items.brief: A class for exporting a paint object into a specified file, from which to recover the paint data later.

items.name: BlendMethod
items.brief: Enumeration indicates the method used for blending paint. Please refer to the respective formulas for each method.

items.name: ColorSpace
items.brief: Enumeration specifying the methods of combining the 8-bit color channels into 32-bit color.

items.name: EngineOption
items.brief: Enumeration to specify rendering engine behavior.

items.name: FillRule
items.brief: Enumeration specifying the algorithm used to establish which parts of the shape are treated as the inside of the shape.

items.name: FillSpread
items.brief: Enumeration specifying how to fill the area outside the gradient bounds.

items.name: FilterMethod
items.brief: Defines the image filtering method used during image scaling or transformation.

items.name: GlyphMetrics
items.brief: Describes the layout metrics of a glyph.

items.name: MaskMethod
items.brief: Enumeration indicating the method used in the mask of two objects - the target and the source.

items.name: Matrix
items.brief: A data structure representing a three-dimensional matrix.

items.name: PathCommand
items.brief: Enumeration specifying the values of the path commands accepted by ThorVG.

items.name: Point
items.brief: A data structure representing a point in two-dimensional space.

items.name: Result
items.brief: Enumeration specifying the result from the APIs.

items.name: SceneEffect
items.brief: Enumeration that defines methods used for Scene Effects.

items.name: StrokeCap
items.brief: Enumeration determining the ending type of a stroke in the open sub-paths.

items.name: StrokeJoin
items.brief: Enumeration determining the style used at the corners of joined stroked path segments.

items.name: TextMetrics
items.brief: Describes the font metrics of a text object.

items.name: TextWrap
items.brief: Enumeration that defines methods used for wrapping text.

items.name: Type
items.brief: Enumeration specifying the ThorVG class type value.
